blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations. In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen’s kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss’ kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.
blocks.zh: 社交媒体是实时公众情绪的丰富来源,但被广泛使用的情绪分析工具往往被应用而不理解其局限性. 在这项研究中,我们评价了三种声波感知分析工具(TextBlob,VADER,和Twitter-roBERTa-base)和三种大语言模型(LLMs:Qune3-32B,GPT-OSS-120B,Llama-4-Maverick-17B)在100条微博上对六位人气感知器的可靠性. 我们用两种统计方法衡量协议: 科恩的卡帕用于对等比较, 即使是在人类评分者中,我们的结果也只显示出公平的一致,突出了情绪分析的主观性. 在二进制情绪分类(阴性与非阴性与阳性)下观察到的一致程度高于人类和自动化工具的三类分类。 推特-ROBERTA基建模式显示, 与人类的评分一致, 表现优于感官工具及LLM, 法学硕士课程显示,他们彼此之间相当一致,与人类有中度和实质性的一致,在积极与非积极分类方面表现较好。 我们的研究结果强调,针对具体领域的微调对于可靠的社交媒体情绪分析仍然至关重要,以人为中心的评价对于建立金标准标签仍然至关重要。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, social media has become a valuable tool to capture real-time public sentiment. Sentiment analysis, a key task in natural language processing (NLP), enables the classification of such text as positive, negative, or neutral. However, the accessibility of existing bespoke sentiment analysis tools has led to their use without fully understanding their limitations. Running text through a tool and accepting its output at face value can be misleading, especially when the nuances of human interpretation are overlooked. Through our study we learned that even humans do not consistently agree on the sentiment of short, context-poor posts, and automated tools inherit the same ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 近年来,社交媒体已成为获取实时公众情绪的宝贵工具. 感官分析是自然语言处理(NLP)中的一项关键任务,它使得这类文本被分类为正文,负文,或中文. 然而,由于可以使用现有的有发言权的情绪分析工具,在没有充分理解其局限性的情况下使用这些工具。 通过一个工具运行文本并按面值接受其输出可能具有误导性,特别是在忽略人类解释的细微差别时. 通过我们的研究,我们了解到,即使是人类也无法一致认同短短、背景差的帖子,自动化工具也继承了同样的模糊性。

blocks.en: In this study, we provide an empirical examination of sentiment analysis reliability by comparing both bespoke tools and modern Large Language Models (LLMs) directly against human judgment. Specifically, we analyzed the sentiment of 100 randomly selected tweets, small enough for detailed, qualitative review using three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob [ 23 ] , VADER [ 15 ] , and Twitter-roBERTa-base model [ 3 ] ) as well as three large language models (Qwen3-32B [ 30 , 14 ] , GPT-OSS-120B [ 12 ] , and Llama-4-Maverick-17B [ 13 ] ), and compared their outputs with the ratings of six human raters. The deliberately small dataset enabled detailed qualitative review and independent manual annotation by all six raters. To measure agreement, we calculated Cohen’s kappa [ 6 ] for each pair of raters (including both humans and tools) and Fleiss’ kappa [ 11 ] for multiple raters.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们通过将标语工具和现代大语言模型(LLMs)直接与人类判断相比较,对情绪分析的可靠性进行实证审查. 具体地说,我们分析了100个随机选择的微博的情绪,这些微博的体积小到足以进行详细、定性的审查,使用三个波音情绪分析工具(TextBlob [23],VADER [15],和Twitter-roBERTa-base模型[3])以及三个大语言模型(Qune3-32B [30,14],GPT-OSS-120B [12],和Llama-4-Maverick-17B [13]),并将其产出与六个人评分的评分相比较。 专门设计的小型数据集使所有6名评定员得以进行详细的质量审查和独立的人工说明。 为了衡量协议,我们计算出科恩的卡帕[6]对每对评分(包括人类和工具)和弗莱斯的卡帕[11]对多个评分.

blocks.en: The main contribution of this work is a direct comparison of three sentiment analysis tools and three LLMs with multiple human raters, using quantitative measures of inter-rater agreement. Our results revealed a cautionary truth: no tool, LLM or otherwise, reliably matches human sentiment judgments, and even human raters only show fair agreement with each other. To address this, we took a majority vote among human raters and then compared it with the tools. Notably, the Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the best alignment with human rating. We also compared three-class (positive, negative, neutral) and binary (negative vs. non-negative, positive vs. non-positive) sentiment classification. Our findings show higher agreement under the binary sentiment classification than under the three-class classification, with negative vs. non-negative distinctions achieving the strongest agreement. Our study provides practical insights for researchers and practitioners on selecting appropriate methods for analyzing social media sentiment, while highlighting that both bespoke tools and modern LLMs struggle to fully capture the nuances of human judgment in short-form social media texts. The persistence of this challenge, along with the assumption that newer or larger models yield more reliable results, underscores the need for careful evaluation and responsible use of automated methods. Sentiment analysis of short social media posts remains inherently noisy, requiring researchers to approach automated tools, old and new, with appropriate caution.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是直接将3个情绪分析工具和3个LLMs与多个人测率器进行比较,使用量度测量的方间协议. 我们的结果显示了一个谨慎的真理:没有任何工具,无论是LLM或其他工具,都可靠地符合人类的情绪判断,甚至人类的评分者也只表现出彼此的公平一致. 为了解决这个问题,我们在人类评分中投了多数票,然后将其与工具进行比较。 值得注意的是,Twitter-roBERTA基建模式显示与人类评级最吻合. 我们还比较了三类(阳性,阴性,中性)和二进制(阴性与非阴性,阳性与非阳性)情绪分类. 我们的调查结果显示,在二进制情绪分类下,比在三类分类下更一致,负与非负的区别达成最强烈的一致。 我们的研究为研究人员和从业者提供了如何选择分析社交媒体情绪的恰当方法的实用见解,同时强调,在短版社交媒体文本中,标语工具和现代LLMS都在努力充分抓住人类判断的细微差别。 这一挑战的持续存在,加上新模式或更大模式产生更可靠结果的假设,突出表明需要认真评价和负责任地使用自动化方法。 对短篇社交媒体文章的感知分析本质上仍然很吵,要求研究人员在使用新旧自动工具时要小心谨慎。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: Sentiment analysis [ 33 , 21 ] is a branch of NLP that examines people’s expressions of emotions, opinions, or stances on a topic. It considers both polarity (positive, negative, or neutral) and valence (emotional intensity) to classify text [ 31 ] . Sentiment analysis is used in many areas including marketing, finance, tourism, politics, and many other fields. Sentiment analysis is also widely applied to social media text, particularly Twitter (now X), where posts are brief, informal, and often filled with slang, hashtags, and sarcasm [ 32 , 1 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 情感分析[33, 21]是NLP的一个分支, 它认为极性(阳性、负性或中性)和等效性(情绪强度)对文本进行分类[31]。 感知分析被用于许多领域,包括营销,金融,旅游,政治,以及许多其他领域. 推特(现在的X)等社交媒体文本也广泛应用感知分析,

blocks.en: For this study, we focused on three representative sentiment analysis tools as well as three LLMs: 1. TextBlob: A Python library for processing textual data that includes a sentiment analysis feature that returns a Sentiment (polarity, subjectivity) tuple, where polarity ranges from [-1.0, 1.0] and subjectivity ranges from [0.0, 1.0]. We only used the polarity score to assign sentiment labels (positive, neutral, and negative) in this study. 2. VADER: A rule-based sentiment analysis model specifically developed for social media text. 3. Twitter-roBERTa-base model: A model trained on 58M tweets and fine-tuned for sentiment analysis with the TweetEval benchmark in 2020 [ 28 , 5 ] . 4. LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Llama-4-Maverick-17B were tested with zero- and one-shot prompting. One-shot prompting performed slightly better or comparable to zero-shot. Since zero-shot results did not affect the overall conclusions, we report only one-shot results for clarity. The results for the zero-shot experiments, along with the prompts used for both the zero-shot and one-shot settings, are available in the project GitHub repository [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于这项研究,我们侧重于三个有代表性的情绪分析工具以及三个有限责任公司: 1. TextBlob:一个用于处理文本数据的Python库,其中包含一个情绪分析特征,它返回一个感官(极性,主观性)的Tuple,其中极性在[-1.0,1.0]之间,主观性在[0.0,1.0]之间. 我们只用极性分数来分配本研究中的情绪标签(正,中,负). 2. VADER:专门为社交媒体文本开发的基于规则的情绪分析模型. 3. 推特-ROBERTa基建模式: 一个在58M微博上接受训练的模型,并用TweetEval基准在2020年进行了情绪分析的微调[28,5]. 4. LLMS: Qwen3-32B,GPT-OSS-120B,Llama-4-Maverick-17B以0发和1发的提示进行测试. 一发即发的表现略好或与零发相比. 由于零镜头结果不影响总体结论,我们只报告一镜头结果,以便明确。 零发实验的结果,以及用于零发和一发设置的提示,都可以在GitHub寄存器项目[17]中找到.

blocks.en: Several studies have used TextBlob, VADER, and BERT-based models for analyzing public sentiment on social media platforms [ 2 , 24 , 7 , 4 ] . Comparative studies show that VADER often outperforms TextBlob for short, casual posts, while transformer-based models excel in capturing nuanced, context-dependent sentiment [ 8 , 18 , 4 ] . Despite these advances, TextBlob and VADER remain widely used due to their simplicity and accessibility [ 10 , 16 ] . More recently, transformer-based models, like BERT [ 9 ] and RoBERTa [ 22 ] , have achieved state-of-the-art performance by capturing complex linguistic and contextual dependencies, particularly when fine-tuned to a specific domain [ 25 , 29 , 26 , 19 ] . Our study offers a comparison of TextBlob and VADER with the fine-tuned Twitter-roBERTa-base model and human judgments, highlighting their strengths and limitations. In another recent study, Kwon et al. [ 20 ] used LLMs to analyze public sentiment on Twitter. They labeled each tweet using seven libraries, including TextBlob and VADER and applied a majority voting approach to label a dataset of 1.26 million tweets. Their evaluation showed that LLMs such as BERT, GPT-2, and Llama-2 outperformed traditional machine learning classifiers.
blocks.zh: 一些研究使用TextBlob、VADER和基于BERT的模型分析社交媒体平台上的公众情绪[2、24、7、4]。 比较研究显示,VADER在短短的、临时的岗位上往往优于TextBlob,而基于变压器的模型则在捕捉细微的、依具体情况而定的情绪[8、18、4]方面表现优异。 尽管取得了这些进步,TextBlob和VADER仍然因其简便性和可访问性而得到广泛使用[10,16]. 最近,基于变压器的模型,如BERT[9]和RoBERTA[22],通过捕捉复杂的语言和背景依赖性,特别是微调到特定领域[25、29、26、19],实现了最先进的性能。 我们的研究提供了TextBlob和VADER与微调的Twitter-roBERTa基模型和人类判断的比较,突出了其优点和局限性. 在最近另一项研究中,Kwon et al. [20] 使用LLMs在Twitter上分析公众情绪. 他们使用包括TextBlob和VADER在内的7个库对每个推文贴上标签,并对126万个推文的数据集贴上标签。 他们的评价表明,BERT、GPT-2和Llama-2等LLMs的成绩超过了传统的机器学习分类器。

blocks.en: In contrast to those previously mentioned works, our study takes a fine-grained approach by evaluating 100 tweets with three sentiment analysis tools and six independent human raters, rather than relying on pre-labeled datasets or large-scale automated labeling. This design enabled us to directly compare output from tools to human judgments and also capture the diversity and subjectivity inherent in human judgment, particularly for informal social media content. By including multiple raters, we can quantify inter-rater agreement and evaluate how closely each tool aligns with human perception, offering insights into tool strengths and limitations in practical social media applications.
blocks.zh: 与之前提到的作品相比,我们的研究采用了精细的处理方法,通过评估100条微博,有3个情绪分析工具和6个独立的人评分,而不是依靠预先贴标签的数据集或大规模自动标签. 这一设计使我们能够直接将工具产出与人类判断进行比较,并抓住人类判断中固有的多样性和主观性,特别是非正式社交媒体内容。 通过纳入多个评分器,我们可以量化评分器之间的协议,并评价每个工具如何与人类感知紧密结合,为实用社交媒体应用中的工具优势和局限性提供见解.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our dataset consists of a subset of 100 tweets [ 17 ] containing the keyword “Site C, Khayelitsha” posted between January 2022 to December 2024, collected as part of a study to assess residents’ perceptions of safety and security in Khayelitsha Township, South Africa. We then generated the sentiment labels by running the three sentiment analysis tools and three LLMs and also by gathering data from six human raters. Those human raters were Computer Science graduate students from our lab with substantial exposure to social media content and sentiment analysis tasks. Hereafter, the six human raters are referred to as R1–R6; the three sentiment analysis tools are referred to as TB (TextBlob), VD (VADER), and RB (Twitter-RoBERTa-base); and the three LLMs are referred to as QW (Qwen3-32B), GP (GPT-OSS-120B), and LM (Llama-4-Maverick-17B).
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集由100条推文组成,其中包含2022年1月至2024年12月期间张贴的“Site C, Khayelitsha”关键词, 然后我们通过运行三个情感分析工具和三个LLMs,以及收集六个人评分的数据,产生了情绪标签。 这些人类的评分是来自我们实验室的计算机科学研究生,他们大量接触社交媒体内容和情绪分析任务. 后世,六人评分称为R1-R6;三种情绪分析工具称为TB(TextBlob),VD(VADER),RB(Twitter-RoBERTa-base);三种LLM被称为QW(Qune3-32B),GP(GPT-OSS-120B),LM(Llama-4-Maverick-17B).

blocks.en: To evaluate the agreement between sentiment analysis tools and human perception, we followed four steps. First, we measured pairwise agreement between human raters and tools using Cohen’s kappa, which provides insight into consistency at the individual rater level. We also tested if simplifying sentiment into binary categories (e.g., negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) improves agreement. Next, we extended the analysis to include multiple raters simultaneously by applying Fleiss’ kappa. As we noticed that the human ratings also varied, we used a majority voting label between human raters which served as a label for evaluating tool performance. No ties occurred during the majority voting process; therefore, no tie-breaking procedure was required.
blocks.zh: 为了评估情绪分析工具和人类认知之间的一致,我们采取了四个步骤。 首先,我们用科恩的卡帕测量了人类评分和工具之间的对等一致,这为个人评分的一致性提供了洞察力。 我们还测试是否将情绪简化为二进制类别(如负数与非负数和正数与非正数)会改善协议. 接下来,我们通过应用 Fleiss 的 kappa 来将分析扩展为包含多个分数。 由于我们注意到人类的评分也各有不同,我们使用了人类评分者之间的多数投票标签,作为评价工具性能的标签。 在多数投票过程中,没有出现任何联系;因此,不需要任何打结程序。

blocks.en: 3.1 Measuring Inter-Rater Agreement: Cohen’s Kappa
blocks.zh: 3.1 测量飞机间协定:科恩的卡帕

blocks.en: Cohen’s kappa coefficient is a statistic that is used to measure inter-rater agreement between two raters for categorical items. The coefficient ranges from -1 to 1, with 1 indicating perfect agreement, 0 if there is no agreement other than what would be expected by chance, and negative values indicating disagreement (agreement worse than chance). Kappa values can be interpreted in the following ranges: -1.00-0.00 (poor agreement), 0.01-0.20 (slight), 0.21-0.40 (fair), 0.41-0.60 (moderate), 0.61-0.80 (substantial), and 0.81-1.00 (almost perfect).
blocks.zh: Cohen的kappa系数是一个统计,用来衡量两个评估者之间对绝对项目达成的对应协议。 系数从-1到-1不等,其中1表示完全一致,0表示除了偶然预期之外没有其他协议,负值表示分歧(协议不如偶然)。 Kappa值可按以下范围解释: -1.00-0.00(贫穷协议),0.01-0.20(浅协议),0.21-0.40(公平),0.41-0.60(中等),0.61-0.80(实质)和0.81-1.00(几乎完美)。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Cohen’s Kappa (a) Positive, Negative, and Neutral, (b) Negative vs Non-Negative, (c) Positive vs Non-Positive. Darker values indicate better agreement.
blocks.zh: 图1:科恩的Kappa(a) 积极、消极和中立,(b) 消极与非消极,(c) 积极与非倾向。 更暗的数值表明更好的一致。

blocks.en: We hypothesized that classifying sentiment as negative vs. non-negative (or even positive vs. non-positive) might yield higher agreement than the traditional positive/negative/neutral categories. This is because humans are generally more adept at identifying distinct positive or negative sentiments, while neutral statements tend to be more ambiguous and prone to subjective interpretation. To test our theory, we calculated the Cohen’s kappa for negative vs. non-negative (Fig. 1 b) and positive vs. non-positive (Fig. 1 c).
blocks.zh: 我们假设,将情绪归类为负面对非负面(或甚至正面对非正面)可能会比传统的积极/负面/中性类别产生更高的共识。 这是因为人类一般更善于识别明显的正面或负面情绪,而中性言论则往往比较模糊,容易被主观解释. 为了检验我们的理论,我们计算了科恩的卡帕对非负数(图1b)和正数对数。 非阳性(图1c)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-Rater Agreement: Fleiss’ Kappa
blocks.zh: 3.2 多飞机协定:Fleiss Kappa

blocks.en: Fleiss’s kappa is a generalization of Cohen’s kappa for more than two raters. In Table 1 , we calculated Fleiss’ kappa to assess inter-rater agreement across multiple raters and tools for various sentiment classification tasks: positive/negative/neutral, negative/non-negative, and positive/non-positive.
blocks.zh: Fleiss的kappa是科恩的kappa的概括, 在表1中,我们计算了Fleiss的kappa,以评估多种评分器之间的评分协议和各种情绪分类任务的工具:阳性/阴性/中性、阴性/非阴性以及阳性/非阳性。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We first calculated the Cohen’s kappa for each pair of raters (Fig. 1 a). The kappa values between human raters and tools vary, with some raters showing moderate agreement (e.g., R1 and R6 with a kappa of 0.52) and others showing fair agreement (e.g., R1 and R2 with a kappa of 0.28). The sentiment analysis tools (TB, VD, and RB) generally have slight to fair agreement with the human raters (R1-R6), indicating that the tools are less consistent with human raters. Among those tools, RB has the highest agreement with a human rater (kappa value of 0.72 with R1). In contrast, the LLMs (LM, GP, and QW) have higher agreement with human raters than other sentiment analysis tools, generally achieving fair to moderate agreement with human raters (R1-R6). Among LLMs, GP has the highest agreement with a human rater (kappa value of 0.74 with R6). Additionally, agreement among the LLMs themselves was substantial, with kappa value of 0.69 (LM and QW), 0.74 (GP and QW), and 0.80 (LM and GP).
blocks.zh: 我们首先计算出科恩的卡帕(图1a)。 人类评分和工具之间的卡帕值各有不同,有些评分显示中度一致(如R1和R6,卡帕为0.52),其他则显示公平一致(如R1和R2,卡帕为0.28). 情绪分析工具(TB,VD,和RB)一般与人评分(R1-R6)有微小到公平的一致,表明工具与人评分不一致. 在这些工具中,RB对人类评分率最高(Kappa值0.72与R1). 相比之下,LLM(LM,GP,和QW)与人评分的一致程度高于其他情绪分析工具,一般与人评分的公平到适度的一致程度(R1-R6). 在LLMs中,GP与人评分(kappa值0.74与R6)的一致度最高. 此外,LLMs本身之间的协议是实质性的,kappa值为0.69(LM和QW)、0.74(GP和QW)和0.80(LM和GP)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Higher Inter-Rater Agreement Under Binary Sentiment Classification
blocks.zh: 4.1 根据二分法分类的较高射线间协定

blocks.en: The kappa values between raters for negative vs. non-negative show significantly higher agreement compared to the three-class sentiment classification in Fig. 1 a. For example, in Fig. 1 b, human raters R1 and R6 achieve almost perfect agreement (kappa = 0.80). RB exhibits the highest agreement with the raters (for example, RB with R1 having an almost perfect kappa value of 0.86), which is similar to what we saw in the three-class classification, but with noticeably stronger agreement in the binary negative vs. non-negative classification. Similarly, the LLMs show strong alignment with human judgments in this binary setting: GP achieves substantial agreement with R1 and R6 (kappa = 0.78), LM with R1 (kappa = 0.74), and QW with R1 (kappa = 0.65). TB and VD still show slight and fair agreement. In particular, VD exhibits poor agreement with R2 (kappa = -0.01); however, this low value is consistent with R2’s generally weak agreement across multiple tools and raters.
blocks.zh: 负数对非负数的评分数之间的卡帕值显示,与图1 a中的三等情感分类相比,一致度明显更高. 例如图1 b中,人类评分数R1和R6实现几乎完美的一致(kappa=0.80). RB表现出与评分最高的一致(例如R1的RB的Kappa值几乎完美到0.86),这与我们在三类分类中看到的相似,但在二进制负数与非负数分类中明显有更强烈的一致. 同样,LLMs在这种二进制环境下表现出与人类判断的强烈一致:GP与R1和R6(kappa=0.78),LM与R1(kappa=0.74),QW与R1(kappa=0.65)达成实质性协议. TB和VD仍然表现出微弱而公正的一致. 特别是,VD与R2(kappa = -0.01)的协议不佳;然而,这一低值与R2在多种工具和评分器之间普遍弱的一致是一致的。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 c, the kappa values for the positive vs. non-positive classification also show a moderate increase in agreement compared to the three-class classification in Fig. 1 a, but the values are generally lower than the negative vs. non-negative classification in Fig. 1 b. For example, R1 and R6 have slight agreement with a kappa value of 0.34. However, as shown in Fig. 1 b, they have almost perfect agreement (kappa value of 0.80) for the negative vs. non-negative classification. RB continues to show better performance in positive vs. non-positive binary classifications (with kappa values like 0.63 with R5). The LLMs showed higher agreement in positive vs. non-positive classification, with substantial to almost perfect agreement in some pairings. TB and VD show weaker agreement in the positive vs. non-positive classification compared to negative vs. non-negative.
blocks.zh: 如图1c所示,正比对非正比分类的卡帕值也显示,与图1a中的三类分类相比,一致度有适度提高,但该值一般低于图1b中的负比对非负比分类. 例如,R1和R6略为一致,卡帕值为0.34. 然而,如图1b所示,它们对于负数与非负数分类几乎完全一致(kappa值为0.80). 经常预算在正比非正比二进制分类(Kappa值如0.63和R5)中继续表现出更好的表现. 有限责任公司在正向与非正向分类中表现出更高的同意度,在一些配对中,基本或几乎完全一致。 TB和VD在阳性与非阳性分类中表现出较弱的一致.

blocks.en: In summary, higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification compared to the three-class classification. For human raters and other non-LLM tools, agreement is generally stronger for negative vs. non-negative, suggesting that negative sentiment is more distinct and easier to identify in our dataset. However, the LLMs tend to agree more with humans on positive sentiment.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,在二进制情绪分类下,与三类分类相比,观察到了更高的一致. 对于人类评分器和其他非LLM工具来说,对于负对非负性,一般都比较一致,说明负面情绪在我们的数据集中更加独特,更容易识别. 然而,LLMs倾向于在积极情绪上更认同人类.

blocks.en: 4.2 Human Consensus via Majority Voting Improves Agreement with Automated Tools
blocks.zh: 4.2 通过多数表决达成的人类共识改进了与自动化工具的协议

blocks.en: Table 1 : Inter-Rater Agreement (Fleiss’ Kappa). The highest kappa value for each classification is shown in bold and highlighted in red .
blocks.zh: 表1:铁路间协定(Fleiss Kappa)。 每个分类的最高卡帕值以粗体显示,以红色突出显示。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the individual human raters had varying interpretations of sentiment, leading to moderate inter-rater agreement at best among themselves and with the sentiment analysis tools. Agreement among LLMs was substantial to near-perfect, whereas agreement between LLMs and human raters remained at most moderate. To address this inconsistency and improve reliability, we applied a majority voting approach, aggregating the most common sentiment label among human raters (Table 2 ). This allowed us to establish a more stable consensus, which we then used to compare against sentiment analysis tools and LLMs. We noticed that applying majority voting among human raters significantly improved consistency, making their collective judgment more aligned with automated tools.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,个人对情绪有不同的解释,因此,他们之间最多可以达成温和的情绪分析工具。 有限责任公司之间的协议是实质性的,几乎完美无缺,而有限责任公司与人员评分公司之间的协议仍然最多。 为了解决这一不一致问题并改进可靠性,我们采用了多数表决办法,将人类评分者中最常见的情绪标签汇总起来(表2)。 这使得我们能建立更稳定的共识,然后我们用来比较情绪分析工具和法学硕士。 我们注意到,在人类评分者中实行多数投票大大改进了一致性,使其集体判断更符合自动化工具。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Human Majority vs. Each Tool / LLM (Cohen’s Kappa). The highest kappa value for each classification is shown in bold and highlighted in red .
blocks.zh: 表2: 人类多数与每个工具/LLM(Cohen的Kappa)。 每个分类的最高卡帕值以粗体显示,以红色突出显示。

blocks.en: RB shows almost perfect agreement with the majority vote of human raters, particularly in negative/non-negative (0.88). It also shows substantial agreement in positive/negative/neutral (0.73) and positive/non-positive (0.61). This indicates that RB is highly consistent with the human majority, especially when distinguishing between negative and non-negative sentiments, and also performs substantially in classifying positive/negative/neutral and positive/non-positive sentiment. TB and VD show fair/moderate agreement, with VD performing moderately in negative/non-negative (0.50) but still demonstrating lower kappa values compared to RB. TB performs the worst, especially in positive/non-positive (0.29), showing fair agreement with the majority vote of human raters. LLM-based models also exhibit strong alignment with the human majority vote. LM achieves substantial agreement and GP shows consistently moderate to substantial agreement. QW demonstrates moderate agreement overall, with comparatively lower performance in the multi-class positive/negative/neutral task. The agreement with the human majority is strongest for the binary sentiment classification for all LLMs. Despite the strong performance of LLMs, the domain-specific RB model remains the most aligned tool with the human majority overall, achieving the highest agreement except in the positive/non-positive setting where LLaMA attains the highest kappa value.
blocks.zh: 经常预算几乎完全赞成多数人的投票,特别是在负/非负(0.88)。 它还表明在正/负/中性(0.73)和正/非正性(0.61)方面基本一致。 这表明,RB与人类多数高度一致,特别是在区分负面和非负面情绪时,而且在将积极/消极/中立和积极/非积极情绪分类方面也发挥了很大的作用。 TB和VD显示公平/中度协议,VD在负/非负性(0.50)中表现中度,但仍显示Kappa值低于RB. 结核病表现最差,特别是在阳性/非阳性(0.29)方面,显示出与大多数人投票一致。 基于LLM的模式也显示出与人类多数选票的强烈一致. LM达成实质性协议,GP表现出一贯的温和到实质性协议. 总体而言,质量评估的一致程度中等,在多级正/负/中性任务中的表现相对较低。 与大多数人的协议对于所有法学硕士的二进制情绪分类最为强烈。 尽管LLMS有很强的性能,但特定域的RB模式仍然是与整个人类多数最一致的工具,除了LLaMA获得最高卡帕值的正/非正环境外,达成最高一致.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Although this study focused on 100 tweets, the deliberately curated dataset enabled independent annotation by six human raters and a detailed evaluation of inter-rater agreement. Expanding this approach to additional topics, geographic regions, and social media communities will help assess the broader applicability of these findings. While the evaluated sentiment analysis tools produce outputs of varying granularity, including continuous polarity scores (e.g., TextBlob and VADER) and class probabilities (e.g., RoBERTa), we converted all outputs into negative, neutral, and positive labels. This decision was made to ensure methodological consistency across all automated systems and human annotators, as the human reference annotations were collected as discrete sentiment categories rather than continuous ratings. We acknowledge that this simplification discards information about sentiment intensity and prediction uncertainty, which may provide additional insight into cases where models or annotators exhibit low confidence or where sentiment is inherently ambiguous. In addition, this study reports point estimates of agreement statistics without confidence intervals or formal significance testing; therefore, differences between agreement values should be interpreted descriptively rather than as statistically established. Future research could complement categorical agreement analyses with continuous or probability-based comparisons and report confidence intervals or hypothesis tests using larger datasets to better capture sentiment intensity, model uncertainty, and the statistical reliability of agreement estimates.
blocks.zh: 尽管这项研究集中在100条微博上,但刻意整理的数据集使得六个人评分员能够独立地进行注释,并对评分间协议进行详细评价. 将这种方法扩大到其他专题、地理区域和社交媒体社区,将有助于评估这些调查结果的更广泛适用性。 虽然被评价的情绪分析工具会产生不同颗粒性的输出,包括连续极性分数(如TextBlob和VADER)和类概率(如RoBERTa),但我们把所有输出转换为负,中和正标签. 作出这一决定是为了确保所有自动化系统和人文注释员在方法上的一致性,因为人类参考说明是作为离散情绪类别而不是连续评级收集的。 我们承认,这种简化忽略了关于情绪强度和预测不确定性的信息,这可能会使人们进一步深入了解模型或注释者表现出的低信心或情绪本身含糊不清的情况。 此外,本研究报告指出协议统计的估计数,而没有设定信任间隔或正式意义测试;因此,协议价值之间的差异应作描述性解释,而不是在统计上确定。 未来的研究可以以连续或基于概率的比较来补充绝对协议分析,并利用更大的数据集来报告信任间隔或假设测试,以便更好地反映情绪强度、模型不确定性以及协议估计数的统计可靠性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: We compared three sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base model) and three LLMs (Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Llama-4-Maverick-17B) on social media text against human judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三种情绪分析工具(TextBlob、VADER和Twitter-roBERTa-base模型)和三种LLM(Qune3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B和Llama-4-Maverick-17B),

blocks.en: Higher agreement under binary sentiment classification: Higher agreement was observed under the negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive classification than under the three-class classification among human raters and between humans and automated tools. For sentiment tools and humans, negative vs. non-negative classification showed the strongest agreement, suggesting that negative sentiment is more distinct and easier to identify than positive sentiment. Interestingly, LLMs performed better on positive vs. non-positive classifications, achieving higher alignment with human judgments in detecting positive sentiment.
blocks.zh: 在二进制情绪分类下更高的协议: 在负数对非负数和正数对非正数分类下,观察到的一致程度高于在人测率者之间以及人与自动化工具之间三类分类下的一致程度。 对于情感工具和人类来说,负面对非负面分类表现出最强烈的认同,表明负面情绪比正面情绪更独特,更容易识别. 有趣的是,LLMS在阳性与非阳性分类上表现较好,在检测阳性情绪时与人类判断更加一致.

blocks.en: Twitter-RoBERTa-base emerges as the most reliable tool in matching human sentiment classifications: It consistently showed substantial/almost perfect agreement with the majority vote across all sentiment categories. This shows that carefully trained, domain-specific models can sometimes outperform even recent general-purpose LLMs.
blocks.zh: 推特-ROBERTA-base成为符合人类情感分类的最可靠工具: 它始终表明,在所有情绪类别中,多数人投了票/几乎完全一致。 这表明,经过认真培训的、针对特定域的模型有时甚至可以超过最近的通用LLM。

blocks.en: LLMs also show strong alignment with human sentiment: LLMs exhibited substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial agreement with the majority vote by humans. LLMs also performed better in binary sentiment classification, with positive vs. non-positive yielding relatively higher agreement. However, general-purpose LLMs, while powerful, do not automatically outperform classical sentiment analysis tools in social media text as they lack task-specific training on social media sentiment.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士也表现出与人类情绪的强烈吻合:法学硕士表现出他们之间的实质性一致,并且对人类多数投票的温和到实质性一致。 在二进制情绪分类方面,LLMS也表现较好,正面与非正面产生相对较高的共识。 但是,通用的LLMS虽然很强大,但不会自动超越社交媒体文本中的古典情绪分析工具,因为它们缺乏针对特定任务的社会媒体情绪培训.

blocks.en: TextBlob and VADER show weaker performance: Both TextBlob and VADER exhibit less agreement, particularly in positive/non-positive, indicating they might struggle with identifying positive sentiments as clearly as negative or non-negative ones. TextBlob showed the lowest agreement across all categories.
blocks.zh: TextBlob和VADER显示性能较弱:TextBlob和VADER都表现出较少的一致,特别是在积极/非积极方面,表明它们可能难以确定积极情绪,如消极或非消极情绪。 TextBlob 显示在所有类别中一致程度最低。

blocks.en: Human-centered evaluation is important for reliable sentiment analysis: Our results showed how even human raters still disagree, highlighting the difficulty of sentiment analysis of social media text. Multi-rater evaluation is essential for establishing a reliable gold standard. Although our dataset includes only 100 tweets, a well-curated, small-scale dataset allows for detailed analysis and multiple human ratings per tweet. Importantly, automated tools or LLMs should not be used to generate ground truth, as they may not always align well with human perception; human-verified labels remain the benchmark for evaluating sentiment.
blocks.zh: 以人为中心的评价对可靠的情绪分析很重要: 我们的结果显示,即使是人类的评测者也仍然持不同意见,这凸显了社交媒体文本情绪分析的难度. 多方评价对建立可靠的金本位至关重要。 虽然我们的数据集仅包括100条微博,但一个精准的,小规模的数据集允许每个微博进行详细的分析和多人评分. 重要的是,不应当使用自动化工具或LLMS来产生地面真相,因为这些工具或LLMS可能并不总是与人类的认知相一致;经过人验证的标签仍然是评价情绪的基准。

blocks.en: Twitter-RoBERTa-base and the LLMs outperform classical lexicon-based tools for sentiment analysis because they apply transformer-based deep learning to understand the context of words. Twitter-RoBERTa-base, as a domain-specific model fine-tuned on TweetEval, is more effective at capturing sentiment than TextBlob and VADER, which rely on fixed rules and lexicons. In contrast, general-purpose LLMs are trained on large corpora but are not specifically adapted to social media text. While LLMs capture nuanced sentiment well, domain-specific fine-tuning could further improve their alignment with human judgments. As these tools continue to advance, our findings are proof positive that the future of sentiment analysis lies in models that truly understand the complexity of human emotions in text and that domain adaptation still remains crucial for reliable sentiment analysis.
blocks.zh: 推特-RoBERTa-base和LLMS超越了基于古典词典的情绪分析工具,因为它们应用基于变压器的深层学习来理解文字的背景. Twitter-RoBERTA-base作为TweetEval上一个特定域名的微调模型,比依赖固定规则和词汇的TextBlob和VADER在捕捉情绪方面更有效. 相比之下,通用的LLMs则接受大型公司培训,但并未具体适应社交媒体文本. 虽然LLMS很好地捕捉了细微的情绪,但针对具体域的微调可以进一步改善其与人类判断的一致性. 随着这些工具的不断推进,我们的调查结果证明是积极的,即情绪分析的未来在于真正理解文字中人类情感复杂性的模型,而领域适应对于可靠的情绪分析仍然至关重要.
